title: D2 automatic cognate clustering against expert judgments

scoring.unit: unordered form pairs within the same concept
scoring.positive_rule: the two forms share at least one confident expert cognate-set label
scoring.automatic_rule: the two forms have the same automatically assigned cognate-set ID
scoring.multiple_expert_labels: retained as a set; any shared label is positive
scoring.scope: only forms with confident expert labels are scored

limitations: Pairwise observations are dependent because each form occurs in multiple pairs.
This is agreement with this expert-coded reference, not an independent gold standard.
The benchmark does not measure semantic correctness, borrowing detection, or phylogenetic accuracy.
No threshold tuning or held-out validation is performed here.
